quest:Walupiggy2.name: Treasure_Hunt_2
quest:Walupiggy2.description: Complete the 2nd Treasure Hunt! Clues are at the official IdleOn youtube channel remember!

quest:Walupiggy3.name: Treasure_Hunt_3

quest:Walupiggy4.name: Treasure_Hunt_4
quest:Walupiggy4.description: Complete the 4th Treasure Hunt! Clues are on the Legends of Idleon youtube channel!

item:Timecandy4.name: 12_HR_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy4.description: Twelve hours, that's a long time! Hold down to instantly get 12 Hour of AFK Gains.

item:Pearl4.name: Black_Pearl
item:Pearl4.description: Hold down to gain 20% EXP in the skill that's shown in the corner of the screen. If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. Only works on skills below level 30.

item:Timecandy5.name: 24_HR_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy5.description: An entire day, just like that! Hold down to instantly get 24 Hour of AFK Gains.

item:TalentPoint6.name: Talent_Point_Special_Tab
item:TalentPoint6.description: Hold down to gain a Talent Point for the Special tab of talents. THIS APPLIES TO ALL CHARACTERS, even ones you haven't made yet, so it doesn't matter which character uses this item.

item:TalentPoint3.name: Talent_Point_Tab_3
item:TalentPoint3.description: Hold down to gain a Talent Point for the third tab of talents. THIS APPLIES TO ALL CHARACTERS, even ones you haven't made yet, so it doesn't matter which character uses this item.

item:StoneHelm6.name: Warped_Helmet_Upgrade_Stone
item:StoneHelm6.description: Drag onto any Helmet to apply. Success Chance; 50% Uses up 1 item slots. WARNING:Slots are used up even if the Upgrade fails!

item:TalentPoint2.name: Talent_Point_Tab_2
item:TalentPoint2.description: Hold down to gain a Talent Point for the second tab of talents. THIS APPLIES TO ALL CHARACTERS, even ones you haven't made yet, so it doesn't matter which character uses this item.

item:Timecandy7.name: Steamy_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy7.description: Thanks for playing on Steam! Hold down to instantly get anywhere from 10 minutes to 24 hours of AFK time!

item:Quest44.name: Goldegg_Capsule
item:Quest44.description: Hold down to summon a mini boss or a green mushroom. It's a 50 50 shot which one you get!

item:CardPack1.name: Newbie_Card_Pack
item:CardPack1.description: Hold down to open the pack! The cards drop on the ground, make sure to pick them up!!
